Response Text:---
The method `placePipe` should convert the given row (1-based) and column character into a `Coordinate` object, then attempt to place the current pipe from the `pipeQueue` onto the map at that coordinate. If successful, it should update the `pipeQueue` (remove the placed pipe), update the `delayBar` (add delay for the new pipe), push the placed cell onto the `cellStack` (for undo functionality), and increment the number of steps.

Here is a complete implementation of the `placePipe` method:

```java
public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
    // Convert column character to 1-based column index (assuming 'A' or 'a' is column 1)
    int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
    Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);

    // Get the current pipe from the pipe queue
    Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
    if (currentPipe == null) {
        return false; // No pipe to place
    }

    // Try to place the pipe on the map
    boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
    if (!placed) {
        return false;
    }

    // Successfully placed the pipe, update game state
    pipeQueue.poll();           // Remove the pipe from the queue
    delayBar.addDelay(currentPipe.getDelay()); // Add delay for the pipe
    Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
    if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
        cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
    }
    numOfSteps++;

    return true;
}
```

**Explanation:**

- Converts the column character to an integer index.
- Uses `pipeQueue.peek()` to get the current pipe without removing it.
- Calls `map.placePipe` to attempt placing the pipe.
- If successful, removes the pipe from the queue (`poll()`), updates the delay bar, pushes the placed cell to the stack, and increments the step count.
- Returns `true` if placed successfully, otherwise `false`.

```java
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
		this.pipeQueue = (pipes == null) ? new PipeQueue() : new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		this.cellStack.clear();
	}
```

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
```java
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
		if (!placed) {
			return false;
		}
		pipeQueue.poll();
		delayBar.addDelay(currentPipe.getDelay());
		Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
		}
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}
```

	 */

```java
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
		}
	}
```

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
```java
		lastCell.clear();
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}
```

	/**
	 * Updates the game state. More specifically, it fills pipes according to the distance the water should flow. <p> This method should invoke  {@link Map#fillTiles(int)}  up to a certain distance. </p>

The errors occur because the methods named `Game` in your class are not constructors but regular methods (they have a return type `void` missing, but even then, constructors should not have a return type). Java constructors must not have a return type and must have the same name as the class. Your current "constructors" are actually methods named `Game` with a `void` return type, so the compiler does not recognize them as constructors.

To fix this, you need to convert these methods into proper constructors by removing the `void` return type.

Here is the corrected `Game` class with proper constructors:

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

    @NotNull
    private final Map map;
    @NotNull
    private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
    @NotNull
    private final DelayBar delayBar;
    @NotNull
    private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

    private int numOfSteps = 0;

    /**
     * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
     *
     * <p>
     * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
     * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
     * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
     * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
     * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
     * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
     */
    @NotNull
    static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
        var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

        return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
    }

    /**
     * Displays the current game state.
     */
    public void display() {
        map.display();
        System.out.println();
        pipeQueue.display();
        cellStack.display();
        System.out.println();
        delayBar.display();
    }

    /**
     * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
     */
    public int getNumOfSteps() {
        return numOfSteps;
    }

    // Proper constructor without delay and pipes
    public Game(int rows, int cols) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
    }

    // Proper constructor with delay and pipes
    public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
        this.pipeQueue = (pipes == null) ? new PipeQueue() : new PipeQueue(pipes);
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
        this.cellStack.clear();
    }

    public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
        int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
        Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
        if (currentPipe == null) {
            return false;
        }
        boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
        if (!placed) {
            return false;
        }
        pipeQueue.poll();
        delayBar.addDelay(currentPipe.getDelay());
        Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
        if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
        }
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
     */
    public void skipPipe() {
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
        if (currentPipe != null) {
            numOfSteps++;
        }
    }

    public boolean undoStep() {
        if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
        lastCell.clear();
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Updates the game state. More specifically, it fills pipes according to the distance the water should flow. <p> This method should invoke  {@link Map#fillTiles(int)}  up to a certain distance. </p>
     */
    public void updateState() {
        int distance = delayBar.getCurrentDelay();
        map.fillTiles(distance);
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the game is won.
     * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
     */
    public boolean hasWon() {
        return map.hasWon();
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the game is lost. <p> Hint: This method should invoke  {@link Map#hasLost()} . You may also need other judgements. </p>
     * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is lost.
     */
    public boolean hasLost() {
        return map.hasLost();
    }
}
```

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

	@NotNull
	private final Map map;
	@NotNull
	private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
	@NotNull
	private final DelayBar delayBar;
	@NotNull
	private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

	private int numOfSteps = 0;

	/**
	 * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
	 * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
	 * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
	 * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current game state.
	 */
	public void display() {
		map.display();
		System.out.println();
		pipeQueue.display();
		cellStack.display();
		System.out.println();
		delayBar.display();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
	 */
	public int getNumOfSteps() {
		// TODO
		return 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
		this.pipeQueue = (pipes == null) ? new PipeQueue() : new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		this.cellStack.clear();
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
		if (!placed) {
			return false;
		}
		pipeQueue.poll();
		delayBar.addDelay(currentPipe.getDelay());
		Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
		}
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
	 */
	public void skipPipe() {
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
		}
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
		lastCell.clear();
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Updates the game state. More specifically, it fills pipes according to the distance the water should flow. <p> This method should invoke  {@link Map#fillTiles(int)}  up to a certain distance. </p>
	 */
	public void updateState() {
		int distance = delayBar.getCurrentDelay();
		map.fillTiles(distance);
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the game is won.
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
	 */
	public boolean hasWon() {
		return map.hasWon();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the game is lost. <p> Hint: This method should invoke  {@link Map#hasLost()} . You may also need other judgements. </p>
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is lost.
	 */
	public boolean hasLost() {
		return map.hasLost();
	}
}
```

package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

    @NotNull
    private final Map map;
    @NotNull
    private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
    @NotNull
    private final DelayBar delayBar;
    @NotNull
    private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

    private int numOfSteps = 0;

    /**
     * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
     *
     * <p>
     * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
     * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
     * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
     * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
     * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
     * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
     */
    @NotNull
    static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
        var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

        return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
    }

    /**
     * Displays the current game state.
     */
    public void display() {
        map.display();
        System.out.println();
        pipeQueue.display();
        cellStack.display();
        System.out.println();
        delayBar.display();
    }

    /**
     * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
     */
    public int getNumOfSteps() {
        return numOfSteps;
    }

    // Proper constructor without delay and pipes
    public Game(int rows, int cols) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
    }

    // Proper constructor with delay and pipes
    public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
        this.pipeQueue = (pipes == null) ? new PipeQueue() : new PipeQueue(pipes);
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
        this.cellStack.clear();
    }

    public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
        int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
        Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
        if (currentPipe == null) {
            return false;
        }
        boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
        if (!placed) {
            return false;
        }
        pipeQueue.poll();
        delayBar.addDelay(currentPipe.getDelay());
        Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
        if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
        }
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
     */
    public void skipPipe() {
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
        if (currentPipe != null) {
            numOfSteps++;
        }
    }

    public boolean undoStep() {
        if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
        lastCell.clear();
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Updates the game state. More specifically, it fills pipes according to the distance the water should flow. <p> This method should invoke  {@link Map#fillTiles(int)}  up to a certain distance. </p>
     */
    public void updateState() {
        int distance = delayBar.getCurrentDelay();
        map.fillTiles(distance);
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the game is won.
     * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
     */
    public boolean hasWon() {
        return map.hasWon();
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the game is lost. <p> Hint: This method should invoke  {@link Map#hasLost()} . You may also need other judgements. </p>
     * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is lost.
     */
    public boolean hasLost() {
        return map.hasLost();
    }
}

```java
     * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
     *
     * <p>
     * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
     * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
     * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
     * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
     * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
     * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
     */
    @NotNull
    static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
        var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

        return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
    }

    /**
     * Displays the current game state.
     */

        map.display();
        System.out.println();
        pipeQueue.display();
        cellStack.display();
        System.out.println();
        delayBar.display();
    }

    /**
     * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
     */
    public int getNumOfSteps() {
        return numOfSteps;
    }

    // Proper constructor without delay and pipes
    public Game(int rows, int cols) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
    }

    // Proper constructor with delay and pipes
    public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
        this.pipeQueue = (pipes == null) ? new PipeQueue() : new PipeQueue(pipes);
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
        this.cellStack.clear();
    }

    public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
        int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
        Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
        if (currentPipe == null) {
            return false;
        }
        boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
        if (!placed) {
            return false;
        }
        pipeQueue.poll();
        delayBar.addDelay(currentPipe.getDelay());
        Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
        if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
        }
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
     */
    public void skipPipe() {
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
        if (currentPipe != null) {
            numOfSteps++;
        }
    }

    public boolean undoStep() {
        if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
        lastCell.clear();
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Updates the game state. More specifically, it fills pipes according to the distance the water should flow. <p> This method should invoke  {@link Map#fillTiles(int)}  up to a certain distance. </p>

	 */
```

```java
		System.out.println("Undo Count: " + count);
	}
```

	void push(final FillableCell cell) {
		cellStack.push(cell);
```java
	}
```

	FillableCell pop() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return null;
		}
		count++;
		return cellStack.pop();
	}

```java
package game;
```

```java
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Class encapsulating the pipe queue.
 */
class PipeQueue {

	/**
	 * Maximum number of pipes to display in the queue.
	 */
	private static final int MAX_GEN_LENGTH = 5;

	@NotNull
	private final LinkedList<Pipe> pipeQueue;

	/**
	 * Displays the current queue.
	 */
	void display() {
		System.out.print("Next Pipes:  ");
		for (var p : pipeQueue) {
			System.out.print(p.toSingleChar() + "    ");
		}
		System.out.println();
	}

	/**
	 * Generates a new pipe.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: Use {@link java.util.Random#nextInt(int)} to generate random numbers.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @return A new pipe.
	 */
	private static Pipe generateNewPipe() {
		// TODO
	}
```

```java
	void PipeQueue() {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}
```

```java
	void PipeQueue(List<Pipe> pipes) {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>(pipes);
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}
```

	Pipe peek() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes in the queue.");
		}
		return pipeQueue.getFirst();
```java
	}
```

	void consume() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes to consume.");
		}
		pipeQueue.removeFirst();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

```java
	void undo(final Pipe pipe) {
```
```java
		pipeQueue.addFirst(pipe);
		if (pipeQueue.size() > MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.removeLast();
		}
	}
```
}

```java
package game;

import game.pipes.Pipe;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Class encapsulating the pipe queue.
 */
class PipeQueue {

	/**
	 * Maximum number of pipes to display in the queue.
	 */
	private static final int MAX_GEN_LENGTH = 5;

	@NotNull
	private final LinkedList<Pipe> pipeQueue;

	/**
	 * Displays the current queue.
	 */
	void display() {
		System.out.print("Next Pipes:  ");
		for (var p : pipeQueue) {
			System.out.print(p.toSingleChar() + "    ");
		}
		System.out.println();
	}

	/**
	 * Generates a new pipe.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: Use {@link java.util.Random#nextInt(int)} to generate random numbers.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @return A new pipe.
	 */
	private static Pipe generateNewPipe() {
		// TODO
	}

	void PipeQueue() {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	void PipeQueue(List<Pipe> pipes) {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>(pipes);
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	Pipe peek() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes in the queue.");
		}
		return pipeQueue.getFirst();
	}

	void consume() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes to consume.");
		}
		pipeQueue.removeFirst();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}
```

	void undo(final Pipe pipe) {
		pipeQueue.addFirst(pipe);
		if (pipeQueue.size() > MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.removeLast();
		}
```java
	}
```
}

        case 1 -> new Pipe(Pipe.Type.CURVED);
        case 2 -> new Pipe(Pipe.Type.CROSS);
        default -> new Pipe(Pipe.Type.STRAIGHT);
    };

The constructor `Map(int rows, int cols)` must initialize the map grid with walls on the edges, one source tile inside (non-edge cell) pointing to a non-wall cell, and one sink tile on the edge pointing outside the map. The rest of the cells should be empty fillable cells.

Here is a complete implementation of the constructor following the requirements and using the helper methods `generateStartCellInfo()` and `generateEndCellInfo()` to place the source and sink tiles properly:

```java
public Map(int rows, int cols) {
    if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
    }
    this.rows = rows;
    this.cols = cols;
    this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];

    // Fill edges with walls
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
                cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
            } else {
                cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
            }
        }
    }

    // Place source cell inside (non-edge)
    TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
    Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;

    // The source cell must not point into a wall, so ensure the adjacent cell in sourceDir is not a wall
    Coordinate sourceTarget = sourceCoord.add(sourceDir.getOffset());
    if (cells[sourceTarget.row][sourceTarget.col] instanceof Wall) {
        // This should not happen due to generateStartCellInfo logic, but just in case:
        throw new IllegalStateException("Source cell points into a wall.");
    }
    sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
    cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;

    // Place sink cell on edge
    TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
    Coordinate sinkCoord;
    Direction sinkDir;
    do {
        sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
        sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
        sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;

        // The sink cell must point outside the map, so the adjacent cell in sinkDir is outside bounds
        Coordinate sinkTarget = sinkCoord.add(sinkDir.getOffset());
        boolean outside = sinkTarget.row < 0 || sinkTarget.row >= rows || sinkTarget.col < 0 || sinkTarget.col >= cols;

        // Also ensure sink cell is not the same as source cell
        if (outside && !sinkCoord.equals(sourceCoord)) {
            break;
        }
    } while (true);

    sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
    cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
}
```

**Explanation:**

- The constructor initializes the `cells` array with walls on the edges and fillable cells inside.
- It uses `generateStartCellInfo()` to get a valid source cell coordinate and direction inside the map.
- It places the source cell as a `TerminationCell` with `isSource=true`.
- It uses `generateEndCellInfo()` to get a valid sink cell coordinate and direction on the edge.
- It places the sink cell as a `TerminationCell` with `isSource=false`.
- The constructor ensures the source does not point into a wall and the sink points outside the map.
- Throws exceptions if the map size is too small or if the source points into a wall (should not happen due to helper logic).

This constructor will create a valid map according to the specification.

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether there exists a path from {@code sourceCell} to {@code sinkCell}.
	 * 
	 * <p>
	 * The game is won when the player must place pipes on the map such that a path is formed from the source tile to the sink tile. public Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
```
    if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
    }
```java
    if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count does not match rows.");
    }
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != cols) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count does not match cols at row " + r);
        }
    }

    this.rows = rows;
    this.cols = cols;
    this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];

    TerminationCell foundSource = null;
    TerminationCell foundSink = null;

    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            Cell cell = cells[r][c];
            if (cell == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null.");
            }
            this.cells[r][c] = cell;

            if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
                Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
                boolean isEdge = r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1;

                if (tc.isSource()) {
                    // Source must be in non-edge cell
                    if (isEdge) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell must not be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
                    }
                    if (foundSource != null) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found.");
                    }
                    // Source must not point into a wall
                    Coordinate target = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
                    if (target.row < 0 || target.row >= rows || target.col < 0 || target.col >= cols) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell points outside the map.");
                    }
                    Cell targetCell = cells[target.row][target.col];
                    if (targetCell instanceof Wall) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell points into a wall.");
                    }
                    foundSource = tc;
                } else {
                    // Sink must be on edge cell
                    if (!isEdge) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
                    }
                    if (foundSink != null) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found.");
                    }
                    // Sink must point outside the map
                    Coordinate target = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
                    boolean outside = target.row < 0 || target.row >= rows || target.col < 0 || target.col >= cols;
                    if (!outside) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must point outside the map.");
                    }
                    foundSink = tc;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (foundSource == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found.");
    }
    if (foundSink == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found.");
    }

    this.sourceCell = foundSource;
    this.sinkCell = foundSink;
```
```java
}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		Coordinate sourceTarget = sourceCoord.add(sourceDir.getOffset());
		if (cells[sourceTarget.row][sourceTarget.col] instanceof Wall) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("Source cell points into a wall.");
		}
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		Coordinate sinkCoord;
		Direction sinkDir;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
			sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
			sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
			Coordinate sinkTarget = sinkCoord.add(sinkDir.getOffset());
			boolean outside = sinkTarget.row < 0 || sinkTarget.row >= rows || sinkTarget.col < 0
					|| sinkTarget.col >= cols;
			if (outside && !sinkCoord.equals(sourceCoord)) {
				break;
			}
		} while (true);
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}
}
```

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		Coordinate sourceTarget = sourceCoord.add(sourceDir.getOffset());
		if (cells[sourceTarget.row][sourceTarget.col] instanceof Wall) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("Source cell points into a wall.");
		}
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		Coordinate sinkCoord;
		Direction sinkDir;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
			sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
			sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
			Coordinate sinkTarget = sinkCoord.add(sinkDir.getOffset());
			boolean outside = sinkTarget.row < 0 || sinkTarget.row >= rows || sinkTarget.col < 0
					|| sinkTarget.col >= cols;
			if (outside && !sinkCoord.equals(sourceCoord)) {
				break;
			}
		} while (true);
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count does not match rows.");
		}
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count does not match cols at row " + r);
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null.");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
					boolean isEdge = r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1;
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell must not be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found.");
						}
						Coordinate target = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (target.row < 0 || target.row >= rows || target.col < 0 || target.col >= cols) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell points outside the map.");
						}
						Cell targetCell = cells[target.row][target.col];
						if (targetCell instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell points into a wall.");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found.");
						}
						Coordinate target = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						boolean outside = target.row < 0 || target.row >= rows || target.col < 0 || target.col >= cols;
						if (!outside) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must point outside the map.");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found.");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found.");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}
}
```

The `undo` method should replace the cell at the given coordinate with a new empty `FillableCell`. Before doing so, it must check that the current cell at that coordinate is indeed a `FillableCell`, otherwise it throws an `IllegalArgumentException`.

Here is a complete implementation of the `undo` method:

```java
public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
    Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
    if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at " + coord + " is not an instance of FillableCell.");
    }
```

```java
}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		Coordinate sourceTarget = sourceCoord.add(sourceDir.getOffset());
		if (cells[sourceTarget.row][sourceTarget.col] instanceof Wall) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("Source cell points into a wall.");
		}
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		Coordinate sinkCoord;
		Direction sinkDir;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
			sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
			sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
			Coordinate sinkTarget = sinkCoord.add(sinkDir.getOffset());
			boolean outside = sinkTarget.row < 0 || sinkTarget.row >= rows || sinkTarget.col < 0
					|| sinkTarget.col >= cols;
			if (outside && !sinkCoord.equals(sourceCoord)) {
				break;
			}
		} while (true);
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count does not match rows.");
		}
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count does not match cols at row " + r);
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null.");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
					boolean isEdge = r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1;
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell must not be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found.");
						}
						Coordinate target = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (target.row < 0 || target.row >= rows || target.col < 0 || target.col >= cols) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell points outside the map.");
						}
						Cell targetCell = cells[target.row][target.col];
						if (targetCell instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell points into a wall.");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found.");
						}
						Coordinate target = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						boolean outside = target.row < 0 || target.row >= rows || target.col < 0 || target.col >= cols;
						if (!outside) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must point outside the map.");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found.");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found.");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int zeroBasedRow = row - 1;
		int zeroBasedCol = col - 1;
		if (zeroBasedRow < 0 || zeroBasedRow >= rows || zeroBasedCol < 0 || zeroBasedCol >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[zeroBasedRow][zeroBasedCol];
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
			if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
				fillableCell.setPipe(p);
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}
```

Response Text:---
The method `fillTiles(int distance)` should fill all pipes within the given distance from the `sourceCell`. A good approach is to use a breadth-first search (BFS) starting from the source cell, expanding outwards up to the specified distance. We keep track of visited/fillable cells to avoid revisiting and fill only those cells that are fillable (e.g., `FillableCell` or `TerminationCell`).

Here's a complete implementation of `fillTiles` using BFS:

```java
public void fillTiles(int distance) {
    if (distance < 0 || sourceCell == null) {
        return;
    }

    filledTiles.clear();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    Map<Coordinate, Integer> distances = new HashMap<>();

    Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
    queue.add(start);
    distances.put(start, 0);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int currentDistance = distances.get(current);

        if (currentDistance > distance) {
            continue;
        }

        Cell cell = cells[current.row][current.col];
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
            fillableCell.setFilled();
            filledTiles.add(current);
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
            terminationCell.setFilled();
            filledTiles.add(current);
        }

        if (currentDistance == distance) {
            continue;
        }

        // Explore neighbors in 4 directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());

            if (neighbor.row < 0 || neighbor.row >= rows || neighbor.col < 0 || neighbor.col >= cols) {
                continue;
            }

            if (distances.containsKey(neighbor)) {
                continue; // already visited
            }

            Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
            // Only fillable cells or termination cells can be filled
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell || neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                queue.add(neighbor);
                distances.put(neighbor, currentDistance + 1);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### Explanation:
- We use a BFS starting from the `sourceCell.coord`.
- We keep a map `distances` to track the distance from the source for each coordinate.
- For each cell within the distance, if it is fillable or a termination cell, we call `setFilled()` and add it to `filledTiles`.
- We only enqueue neighbors that are fillable or termination cells and haven't been visited yet.
- The BFS stops expanding beyond the given distance.

This approach ensures all fillable cells within the specified distance from the source are filled correctly.

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;

			break;

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		Coordinate sourceTarget = sourceCoord.add(sourceDir.getOffset());
		if (cells[sourceTarget.row][sourceTarget.col] instanceof Wall) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("Source cell points into a wall.");
		}
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		Coordinate sinkCoord;
		Direction sinkDir;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
			sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
			sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
			Coordinate sinkTarget = sinkCoord.add(sinkDir.getOffset());
			boolean outside = sinkTarget.row < 0 || sinkTarget.row >= rows || sinkTarget.col < 0
					|| sinkTarget.col >= cols;
			if (outside && !sinkCoord.equals(sourceCoord)) {
				break;
			}
		} while (true);
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count does not match rows.");
		}
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count does not match cols at row " + r);
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null.");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
					boolean isEdge = r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1;
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell must not be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found.");
						}
						Coordinate target = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (target.row < 0 || target.row >= rows || target.col < 0 || target.col >= cols) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell points outside the map.");
						}
						Cell targetCell = cells[target.row][target.col];
						if (targetCell instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell points into a wall.");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found.");
						}
						Coordinate target = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						boolean outside = target.row < 0 || target.row >= rows || target.col < 0 || target.col >= cols;
						if (!outside) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must point outside the map.");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found.");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found.");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int zeroBasedRow = row - 1;
		int zeroBasedCol = col - 1;
		if (zeroBasedRow < 0 || zeroBasedRow >= rows || zeroBasedCol < 0 || zeroBasedCol >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[zeroBasedRow][zeroBasedCol];
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
			if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
				fillableCell.setPipe(p);
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at " + coord + " is not an instance of FillableCell.");
		}
		cells[coord.row][coord.col] = new FillableCell(coord);
	}
}
```

public void fillTiles(int distance) {

        return;

    filledTiles.clear();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    Map<Coordinate, Integer> distances = new HashMap<>();

    Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
    queue.add(start);
    distances.put(start, 0);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int currentDistance = distances.get(current);

        if (currentDistance > distance) {
            continue;
        }

        Cell cell = cells[current.row][current.col];
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
            fillableCell.setFilled();
            filledTiles.add(current);
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
            terminationCell.setFilled();
            filledTiles.add(current);
        }

        if (currentDistance == distance) {
            continue;
        }

        // Explore neighbors in 4 directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());

            if (neighbor.row < 0 || neighbor.row >= rows || neighbor.col < 0 || neighbor.col >= cols) {
                continue;

            if (distances.containsKey(neighbor)) {
                continue; // already visited

            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell || neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                queue.add(neighbor);
                distances.put(neighbor, currentDistance + 1);
            }
        }

Response Text:---
The method `checkPath` should determine if there is a valid path from the `sourceCell` to the `sinkCell` through connected pipes and cells. A Breadth-First Search (BFS) is a suitable approach here. The BFS will start from the source cell and explore neighbors that are connected via pipes in a compatible way (i.e., the pipe in the current cell connects to the pipe in the neighbor cell in the correct directions). If the sink cell is reached, return `true`; otherwise, return `false`.

Below is a complete implementation of `checkPath()` using BFS. It assumes that the connectivity between cells depends on the pipes and their directions, so it checks if the pipes in adjacent cells connect properly.

```java
public boolean checkPath() {
    if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
        return false;
    }

    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();

    queue.add(sourceCell.coord);
    visited.add(sourceCell.coord);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        if (current.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
            return true;
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];
        if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell || currentCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
            continue;
        }

        // Get the pipe in the current cell (if any)
        Pipe currentPipe = null;
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
            currentPipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            // TerminationCell is considered connected in the direction it faces
            // We can treat it as having a pipe that connects in the direction of the termination cell
            // For simplicity, treat TerminationCell as connected in its direction
            currentPipe = null; // no pipe, but special handling below
        }

        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (neighborCoord.row < 0 || neighborCoord.row >= rows || neighborCoord.col < 0 || neighborCoord.col >= cols) {
                continue;
            }
            if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }

            Cell neighborCell = cells[neighborCoord.row][neighborCoord.col];
            if (!(neighborCell instanceof FillableCell || neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
                continue;
            }

            Pipe neighborPipe = null;
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell fillableNeighbor) {
                neighborPipe = fillableNeighbor.getPipe();
                if (neighborPipe == null) {
                    continue; // no pipe to connect to
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell terminationNeighbor) {
                // TerminationCell special case
                // We consider it connected if the direction of the termination cell is opposite to the direction we come from
                // i.e. if we enter the termination cell from the correct side
                Direction neighborDir = terminationNeighbor.getDirection();
                if (!neighborCoord.equals(sinkCell.coord) && !neighborCoord.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
                    // Only sink or source cells are termination cells, so skip others
                    continue;
                }
                // Check if neighbor termination cell faces opposite direction of dir
                if (neighborDir != dir.getOpposite()) {
                    continue;
                }
                // If this is sinkCell, we can consider it connected
                if (neighborCoord.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    continue;
                }
                if (neighborCoord.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
                    // source cell, allow connection if direction matches
                    if (neighborDir != dir.getOpposite()) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    continue;
                }
                continue;
            }

            // Check if current pipe connects to neighbor pipe in the direction dir
            if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                // sourceCell: check if it connects in direction dir
                Direction sourceDir = sourceCell.getDirection();
                if (!current.equals(sourceCell.coord) || dir != sourceDir) {
                    continue;
                }
            } else {
                if (currentPipe == null || !currentPipe.connects(dir)) {
                    continue;
                }
            }

            // Check if neighbor pipe connects back in opposite direction
            if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                Direction neighborDir = ((TerminationCell) neighborCell).getDirection();
                if (neighborDir != dir.getOpposite()) {
                    continue;
                }
            } else {
                if (neighborPipe == null || !neighborPipe.connects(dir.getOpposite())) {
                    continue;
                }
            }

            queue.add(neighborCoord);
            visited.add(neighborCoord);
        }
    }

    return false;
}
```

**Explanation:**

- BFS starts from the source cell coordinate.
- For each cell, it checks neighbors in all directions.
- It verifies that the current cell's pipe connects in the direction of the neighbor.
- It verifies that the neighbor's pipe connects back in the opposite direction.
- Special handling for `TerminationCell` (source and sink) to check their direction.
- If the sink cell is reached, return `true`.
- If BFS finishes without reaching sink, return `false`.

This method relies on the `Pipe` class having a method `connects(Direction dir)` that returns `true` if the pipe has an opening in that direction. This is consistent with typical pipe connection logic.

```java
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the map is incorrectly formatted.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Map fromString(int rows, int cols, @NotNull String cellsRep) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col).
	 *
	 * @param coord Coordinate to place pipe at.
	 * @param pipe  Pipe to place in cell.
	 * @return {@code true} if the pipe is placed in the cell, {@code false} otherwise.
	 */
	public boolean tryPlacePipe(@NotNull final Coordinate coord, @NotNull final Pipe pipe) {
		return tryPlacePipe(coord.row, coord.col, pipe);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current map.
	 */
	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void fillBeginTile() {
		sourceCell.setFilled();
	}

	@NotNull
	private List<Coordinate> getTraversedCoords() {
		return new ArrayList<>(filledTiles);
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		Coordinate sourceTarget = sourceCoord.add(sourceDir.getOffset());
		if (cells[sourceTarget.row][sourceTarget.col] instanceof Wall) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("Source cell points into a wall.");
		}
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		Coordinate sinkCoord;
		Direction sinkDir;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
			sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
			sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
			Coordinate sinkTarget = sinkCoord.add(sinkDir.getOffset());
			boolean outside = sinkTarget.row < 0 || sinkTarget.row >= rows || sinkTarget.col < 0
					|| sinkTarget.col >= cols;
			if (outside && !sinkCoord.equals(sourceCoord)) {
				break;
			}
		} while (true);
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3.");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count does not match rows.");
		}
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count does not match cols at row " + r);
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null.");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
					boolean isEdge = r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1;
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell must not be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found.");
						}
						Coordinate target = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (target.row < 0 || target.row >= rows || target.col < 0 || target.col >= cols) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell points outside the map.");
						}
						Cell targetCell = cells[target.row][target.col];
						if (targetCell instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell points into a wall.");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ").");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found.");
						}
						Coordinate target = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						boolean outside = target.row < 0 || target.row >= rows || target.col < 0 || target.col >= cols;
						if (!outside) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must point outside the map.");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found.");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found.");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int zeroBasedRow = row - 1;
		int zeroBasedCol = col - 1;
		if (zeroBasedRow < 0 || zeroBasedRow >= rows || zeroBasedCol < 0 || zeroBasedCol >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[zeroBasedRow][zeroBasedCol];
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
			if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
				fillableCell.setPipe(p);
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at " + coord + " is not an instance of FillableCell.");
		}
		cells[coord.row][coord.col] = new FillableCell(coord);
	}

	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		if (distance < 0 || sourceCell == null) {
			return;
		}
		filledTiles.clear();
		Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
		Map<Coordinate, Integer> distances = new HashMap<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
		queue.add(start);
		distances.put(start, 0);
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate current = queue.poll();
			int currentDistance = distances.get(current);
			if (currentDistance > distance) {
				continue;
			}
			Cell cell = cells[current.row][current.col];
			if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
				fillableCell.setFilled();
				filledTiles.add(current);
			} else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
				terminationCell.setFilled();
				filledTiles.add(current);
			}
			if (currentDistance == distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (neighbor.row < 0 || neighbor.row >= rows || neighbor.col < 0 || neighbor.col >= cols) {
					continue;
				}
				if (distances.containsKey(neighbor)) {
					continue;
				}
				Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
				if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell || neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
					queue.add(neighbor);
					distances.put(neighbor, currentDistance + 1);
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
```
