package pa1.model;

import pa1.controller.GameBoardController;
import pa1.view.GameBoardView;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Class for tracking the state of multiple game components.
 */
public class GameState {

    /**
     * Number representing unlimited number of lives for a player.
     */
    public static final int UNLIMITED_LIVES = -1;

    /**
     * The game board managed by this instance.
     */
    @NotNull
    private final GameBoard gameBoard;

    /**
     * {@link MoveStack} instance of all moves performed by the player.
     */
    @NotNull
    private final MoveStack moveStack = new MoveStack();

    /**
     * The number of deaths of the player.
     */
    private int numDeaths = 0;

    /**
     * The number of moves performed by the player (excluding invalid moves).
     */
    private int numMoves = 0;

    /**
     * The number of lives the player has.
     */
    private int numLives;

    /**
     * The number of gems initially on the game board when this instance was created.
     */
    private final int initialNumOfGems;

    /**
     * @return The instance of the managed {@link MoveStack}.
     */
    public MoveStack getMoveStack() {
        return moveStack;
    }

    // Corrected constructors (no void return type)

    public GameState(final GameBoard gameBoard) {
        this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard must not be null");
        this.numLives = UNLIMITED_LIVES;
        this.initialNumOfGems = gameBoard.getNumGems();
    }

    public GameState(final GameBoard gameBoard, final int numLives) {
        this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard must not be null");
        if (numLives < 0) {
            this.numLives = UNLIMITED_LIVES;
        } else {
            this.numLives = numLives;
        }
        this.initialNumOfGems = gameBoard.getNumGems();
    }

    // ... rest of the class unchanged ...
}

Response Text:---
The errors occur because the constructors in your `GameState` class are incorrectly declared as methods with a `void` return type, so they are not recognized as constructors by Java. You must remove the `void` keyword from the constructor declarations to properly define them as constructors.

Here is the corrected complete `GameState` class with proper constructors:

```java
package pa1.model;

import pa1.controller.GameBoardController;
import pa1.view.GameBoardView;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Class for tracking the state of multiple game components.
 */
public class GameState {

    /**
     * Number representing unlimited number of lives for a player.
     */
    public static final int UNLIMITED_LIVES = -1;

    /**
     * The game board managed by this instance.
     */
    @NotNull
    private final GameBoard gameBoard;

    /**
     * {@link MoveStack} instance of all moves performed by the player.
     */
    @NotNull
    private final MoveStack moveStack = new MoveStack();

    /**
     * The number of deaths of the player.
     */
    private int numDeaths = 0;

    /**
     * The number of moves performed by the player (excluding invalid moves).
     */
    private int numMoves = 0;

    /**
     * The number of lives the player has.
     */
    private int numLives;

    /**
     * The number of gems initially on the game board when this instance was created.
     */
    private final int initialNumOfGems;

    /**
     * @return The instance of the managed {@link MoveStack}.
     */
    public MoveStack getMoveStack() {
        return moveStack;
    }

    // Correct constructors without void return type

    public GameState(final GameBoard gameBoard) {
        this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard must not be null");
        this.numLives = UNLIMITED_LIVES;
        this.initialNumOfGems = gameBoard.getNumGems();
    }

    public GameState(final GameBoard gameBoard, final int numLives) {
        this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard must not be null");
        if (numLives < 0) {
            this.numLives = UNLIMITED_LIVES;
        } else {
            this.numLives = numLives;
        }
        this.initialNumOfGems = gameBoard.getNumGems();
    }

    // ... rest of the class unchanged ...
}
```

**Explanation:**  
- Constructors must not have a return type, not even `void`.  
- Your original code had `public void GameState(...)` which is a method, not a constructor, so the compiler does not recognize it as a constructor.  
- Changing `public void GameState(...)` to `public GameState(...)` fixes the compilation errors related to constructor calls.  

After this fix, the tests that instantiate `GameState` with `new GameState(GameBoard)` or `new GameState(GameBoard, int)` will compile and run correctly.

Response Text:---
The `parse` method needs to read the undo limit from the first line, then parse each subsequent line as a row of the game map. It must create entities according to the characters, track players and boxes, and validate the constraints (undo limit, unique players, matching boxes and destinations, etc.). Finally, it returns a new `GameMap` instance with the parsed data.

Here is a complete implementation of the `parse` method:

```java
public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
    if (mapText == null || mapText.isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
    }
    String[] lines = mapText.split("\\R"); // split by any line separator
    if (lines.length < 2) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
    }

    // Parse undo limit
    int undoLimit;
    try {
        undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be an integer");
    }
    if (undoLimit < -1 || (undoLimit < 0 && undoLimit != -1)) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be -1 or non-negative");
    }

    int height = lines.length - 1;
    int width = lines[1].length();

    Map<Position, Entity> map = new HashMap<>();
    Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();

    Map<Character, Player> playersByChar = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Character, Position> playerPositions = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Character, List<Box>> boxesByPlayerChar = new HashMap<>();

    int boxCount = 0;
    int destinationCount = 0;

    for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
        String line = lines[y + 1];
        if (line.length() != width) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("All map lines must have the same width");
        }
        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
            char c = line.charAt(x);
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            Entity entity;
            if (c == '#') {
                entity = new Wall();
            } else if (c == '@') {
                entity = new Empty();
                destinations.add(pos);
                destinationCount++;
            } else if (c == '.') {
                entity = new Empty();
            } else if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) {
                // Player
                if (playersByChar.containsKey(c)) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player character: " + c);
                }
                Player player = new Player(c - 'A');
                playersByChar.put(c, player);
                playerPositions.put(c, pos);
                entity = player;
            } else if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) {
                // Box
                char playerChar = Character.toUpperCase(c);
                Box box = new Box(playerChar - 'A');
                boxesByPlayerChar.computeIfAbsent(playerChar, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(box);
                entity = box;
                boxCount++;
            } else {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid character in map: " + c);
            }
            map.put(pos, entity);
        }
    }

    if (playersByChar.isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one player on the map");
    }

    if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes must equal number of box destinations");
    }

    // Validate boxes and players correspondence
    Set<Character> playerChars = playersByChar.keySet();
    Set<Character> boxPlayerChars = boxesByPlayerChar.keySet();

    // Boxes must have matching players
    for (char boxPlayerChar : boxPlayerChars) {
        if (!playerChars.contains(boxPlayerChar)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Box player '" + boxPlayerChar + "' has no matching player on the board");
        }
    }
    // Players must have at least one box
    for (char playerChar : playerChars) {
        if (!boxPlayerChars.contains(playerChar)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player '" + playerChar + "' has no corresponding boxes");
        }
    }

    return new GameMap(map, destinations, undoLimit);
}
```

**Explanation:**

- Splits the input into lines.
- Parses the undo limit and validates it.
- Reads each map line, checking width consistency.
- For each character, creates the corresponding entity.
- Tracks players and boxes by their characters.
- Checks for duplicate players.
- Collects box destinations.
- Validates that the number of boxes equals the number of destinations.
- Validates that each box's player exists and each player has boxes.
- Throws `IllegalArgumentException` on invalid input.
- Returns a new `GameMap` with the constructed map, destinations, and undo limit.

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\R");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be an integer");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1 || (undoLimit < 0 && undoLimit != -1)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be -1 or non-negative");
		}
		int height = lines.length - 1;
		int width = lines[1].length();
		Map<Position, Entity> map = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Player> playersByChar = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playerPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, List<Box>> boxesByPlayerChar = new HashMap<>();
		int boxCount = 0;
		int destinationCount = 0;
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			if (line.length() != width) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All map lines must have the same width");
			}
			for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
				char c = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity;
				if (c == '#') {
					entity = new Wall();
				} else if (c == '@') {
					entity = new Empty();
					destinations.add(pos);
					destinationCount++;
				} else if (c == '.') {
					entity = new Empty();
				} else if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) {
					if (playersByChar.containsKey(c)) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player character: " + c);
					}
					Player player = new Player(c - 'A');
					playersByChar.put(c, player);
					playerPositions.put(c, pos);
					entity = player;
				} else if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) {
					char playerChar = Character.toUpperCase(c);
					Box box = new Box(playerChar - 'A');
					boxesByPlayerChar.computeIfAbsent(playerChar, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(box);
					entity = box;
					boxCount++;
				} else {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid character in map: " + c);
				}
				map.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		if (playersByChar.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one player on the map");
		}
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes must equal number of box destinations");
		}
		Set<Character> playerChars = playersByChar.keySet();
		Set<Character> boxPlayerChars = boxesByPlayerChar.keySet();
		for (char boxPlayerChar : boxPlayerChars) {
			if (!playerChars.contains(boxPlayerChar)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box player '" + boxPlayerChar + "' has no matching player on the board");
			}
		}
		for (char playerChar : playerChars) {
			if (!boxPlayerChars.contains(playerChar)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player '" + playerChar + "' has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		return new GameMap(map, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity object at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity in the game map.
	 * @return  Entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return map.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}
}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\R");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be an integer");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1 || (undoLimit < 0 && undoLimit != -1)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be -1 or non-negative");
		}
		int height = lines.length - 1;
		int width = lines[1].length();
		Map<Position, Entity> map = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Player> playersByChar = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playerPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, List<Box>> boxesByPlayerChar = new HashMap<>();
		int boxCount = 0;
		int destinationCount = 0;
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			if (line.length() != width) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All map lines must have the same width");
			}
			for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
				char c = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity;
				if (c == '#') {
					entity = new Wall();
				} else if (c == '@') {
					entity = new Empty();
					destinations.add(pos);
					destinationCount++;
				} else if (c == '.') {
					entity = new Empty();
				} else if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) {
					if (playersByChar.containsKey(c)) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player character: " + c);
					}
					Player player = new Player(c - 'A');
					playersByChar.put(c, player);
					playerPositions.put(c, pos);
					entity = player;
				} else if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) {
					char playerChar = Character.toUpperCase(c);
					Box box = new Box(playerChar - 'A');
					boxesByPlayerChar.computeIfAbsent(playerChar, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(box);
					entity = box;
					boxCount++;
				} else {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid character in map: " + c);
				}
				map.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		if (playersByChar.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one player on the map");
		}
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes must equal number of box destinations");
		}
		Set<Character> playerChars = playersByChar.keySet();
		Set<Character> boxPlayerChars = boxesByPlayerChar.keySet();
		for (char boxPlayerChar : boxPlayerChars) {
			if (!playerChars.contains(boxPlayerChar)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box player '" + boxPlayerChar + "' has no matching player on the board");
			}
		}
		for (char playerChar : playerChars) {
			if (!boxPlayerChars.contains(playerChar)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player '" + playerChar + "' has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		return new GameMap(map, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import assignment.entities.Wall;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * A Sokoban game board.
 * GameBoard consists of information loaded from map data, such as
 * <li>Width and height of the game map</li>
 * <li>Walls in the map</li>
 * <li>Box destinations</li>
 * <li>Initial locations of boxes and player</li>
 * <p/>
 * GameBoard is capable to create many GameState instances, each representing an ongoing game.
 */
public class GameMap {

	private final Map<Position, Entity> map;

	private final int maxWidth;

	private final int maxHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private final int undoLimit;

	/**
	 * Create a new GameMap with width, height, set of box destinations and undo limit.
	 *
	 * @param maxWidth     Width of the game map.
	 * @param maxHeight    Height of the game map.
	 * @param destinations Set of box destination positions.
	 * @param undoLimit    Undo limit.
	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
	 */
	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\R");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be an integer");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1 || (undoLimit < 0 && undoLimit != -1)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be -1 or non-negative");
		}
		int height = lines.length - 1;
		int width = lines[1].length();
		Map<Position, Entity> map = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Player> playersByChar = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playerPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, List<Box>> boxesByPlayerChar = new HashMap<>();
		int boxCount = 0;
		int destinationCount = 0;
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			if (line.length() != width) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All map lines must have the same width");
			}
			for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
				char c = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity;
				if (c == '#') {
					entity = new Wall();
				} else if (c == '@') {
					entity = new Empty();
					destinations.add(pos);
					destinationCount++;
				} else if (c == '.') {
					entity = new Empty();
				} else if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) {
					if (playersByChar.containsKey(c)) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player character: " + c);
					}
					Player player = new Player(c - 'A');
					playersByChar.put(c, player);
					playerPositions.put(c, pos);
					entity = player;
				} else if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) {
					char playerChar = Character.toUpperCase(c);
					Box box = new Box(playerChar - 'A');
					boxesByPlayerChar.computeIfAbsent(playerChar, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(box);
					entity = box;
					boxCount++;
				} else {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid character in map: " + c);
				}
				map.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		if (playersByChar.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one player on the map");
		}
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes must equal number of box destinations");
		}
		Set<Character> playerChars = playersByChar.keySet();
		Set<Character> boxPlayerChars = boxesByPlayerChar.keySet();
		for (char boxPlayerChar : boxPlayerChars) {
			if (!playerChars.contains(boxPlayerChar)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box player '" + boxPlayerChar + "' has no matching player on the board");
			}
		}
		for (char playerChar : playerChars) {
			if (!boxPlayerChars.contains(playerChar)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player '" + playerChar + "' has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		return new GameMap(map, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity object at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity in the game map.
	 * @return  Entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return map.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	/**
	 * Put one entity at the given position in the game map.
	 * @param position  the position in the game map to put the entity.
	 * @param entity    the entity to put into game map.
	 */
	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(position, "Position cannot be null");
		Objects.requireNonNull(entity, "Entity cannot be null");
		map.put(position, entity);
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the undo limit of the game map.
	 * @return  undo limit.
	 */
	public Optional<Integer> getUndoLimit() {
		if (undoLimit == 0) {
			return Optional.empty();
		}
		return Optional.of(undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get all players' id as a set.
	 * @return  a set of player id.
	 */
	public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
		return map.values().stream().filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player).map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map.
	 * @return  maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMaxWidth() {
		return maxWidth;
	}
}

Response Text:---
The error occurs because the current `parse` method requires all map lines to have the same width, but the tests provide maps with lines of varying lengths. To fix this, the parser should allow non-rectangular maps by determining the maximum width among all lines and padding shorter lines with spaces (or a default empty entity) so that all lines have the same width internally.

Here is the corrected `GameMap` class with an updated `parse` method that handles non-rectangular maps by padding shorter lines with spaces and adjusting width accordingly:

```java
package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import assignment.entities.Wall;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * A Sokoban game board.
 * GameBoard consists of information loaded from map data, such as
 * <li>Width and height of the game map</li>
 * <li>Walls in the map</li>
 * <li>Box destinations</li>
 * <li>Initial locations of boxes and player</li>
 * <p/>
 * GameBoard is capable to create many GameState instances, each representing an ongoing game.
 */
public class GameMap {

	private final Map<Position, Entity> map;

	private final int maxWidth;

	private final int maxHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private final int undoLimit;

	/**
	 * Create a new GameMap with width, height, set of box destinations and undo limit.
	 *
	 * @param maxWidth     Width of the game map.
	 * @param maxHeight    Height of the game map.
	 * @param destinations Set of box destination positions.
	 * @param undoLimit    Undo limit.
	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
	 */
	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMaxHeight() {
		return maxHeight;
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\R");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be an integer");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1 || (undoLimit < 0 && undoLimit != -1)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be -1 or non-negative");
		}
		int height = lines.length - 1;

		// Determine max width among all lines (not just first line)
		int maxWidth = 0;
		for (int i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
			if (lines[i].length() > maxWidth) {
				maxWidth = lines[i].length();
			}
		}

		Map<Position, Entity> map = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Player> playersByChar = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playerPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, List<Box>> boxesByPlayerChar = new HashMap<>();
		int boxCount = 0;
		int destinationCount = 0;

		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			// Pad line with spaces if shorter than maxWidth
			if (line.length() < maxWidth) {
				line = String.format("%-" + maxWidth + "s", line);
			}
			for (int x = 0; x < maxWidth; x++) {
				char c = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity;
				if (c == '#') {
					entity = new Wall();
				} else if (c == '@') {
					entity = new Empty();
					destinations.add(pos);
					destinationCount++;
				} else if (c == '.') {
					entity = new Empty();
				} else if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) {
					if (playersByChar.containsKey(c)) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player character: " + c);
					}
					Player player = new Player(c - 'A');
					playersByChar.put(c, player);
					playerPositions.put(c, pos);
					entity = player;
				} else if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) {
					char playerChar = Character.toUpperCase(c);
					Box box = new Box(playerChar - 'A');
					boxesByPlayerChar.computeIfAbsent(playerChar, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(box);
					entity = box;
					boxCount++;
				} else if (c == ' ' || c == '\t') {
					// Treat spaces and tabs as empty
					entity = new Empty();
				} else {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid character in map: " + c);
				}
				map.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		if (playersByChar.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one player on the map");
		}
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes must equal number of box destinations");
		}
		Set<Character> playerChars = playersByChar.keySet();
		Set<Character> boxPlayerChars = boxesByPlayerChar.keySet();
		for (char boxPlayerChar : boxPlayerChars) {
			if (!playerChars.contains(boxPlayerChar)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box player '" + boxPlayerChar + "' has no matching player on the board");
			}
		}
		for (char playerChar : playerChars) {
			if (!boxPlayerChars.contains(playerChar)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player '" + playerChar + "' has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		return new GameMap(map, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity object at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity in the game map.
	 * @return  Entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return map.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	/**
	 * Put one entity at the given position in the game map.
	 * @param position  the position in the game map to put the entity.
	 * @param entity    the entity to put into game map.
	 */
	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(position, "Position cannot be null");
		Objects.requireNonNull(entity, "Entity cannot be null");
		map.put(position, entity);
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the undo limit of the game map.
	 * @return  undo limit.
	 */
	public Optional<Integer> getUndoLimit() {
		if (undoLimit == 0) {
			return Optional.empty();
		}
		return Optional.of(undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get all players' id as a set.
	 * @return  a set of player id.
	 */
	public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
		return map.values().stream().filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player).map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map.
	 * @return  maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMaxWidth() {
		return maxWidth;
	}
}
```

**Explanation:**  
- The `parse` method now computes the maximum width among all map lines, not just the first line.  
- Each line is padded with spaces to this maximum width before processing.  
- Spaces and tabs are treated as empty tiles (`Empty` entity).  
- This allows non-rectangular maps to be parsed without throwing an exception about line width mismatch.  

This change should fix the `IllegalArgumentException` errors in your tests related to map line width.

		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMaxHeight() {
		return maxHeight;
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\R");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be an integer");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1 || (undoLimit < 0 && undoLimit != -1)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be -1 or non-negative");
		}
		int height = lines.length - 1;

		// Determine max width among all lines (not just first line)
		int maxWidth = 0;
		for (int i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
			if (lines[i].length() > maxWidth) {
				maxWidth = lines[i].length();
			}
		}

		Map<Position, Entity> map = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Player> playersByChar = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playerPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, List<Box>> boxesByPlayerChar = new HashMap<>();
		int boxCount = 0;
		int destinationCount = 0;

		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			// Pad line with spaces if shorter than maxWidth
			if (line.length() < maxWidth) {
				line = String.format("%-" + maxWidth + "s", line);
			}
			for (int x = 0; x < maxWidth; x++) {
				char c = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity;
				if (c == '#') {
					entity = new Wall();
				} else if (c == '@') {
					entity = new Empty();
					destinations.add(pos);
					destinationCount++;
				} else if (c == '.') {
					entity = new Empty();
				} else if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) {
					if (playersByChar.containsKey(c)) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player character: " + c);
					}
					Player player = new Player(c - 'A');
					playersByChar.put(c, player);
					playerPositions.put(c, pos);
					entity = player;
				} else if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) {
					char playerChar = Character.toUpperCase(c);
					Box box = new Box(playerChar - 'A');
					boxesByPlayerChar.computeIfAbsent(playerChar, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(box);
					entity = box;
					boxCount++;
				} else if (c == ' ' || c == '\t') {
					// Treat spaces and tabs as empty
					entity = new Empty();
				} else {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid character in map: " + c);
				}
				map.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		if (playersByChar.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one player on the map");
		}
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes must equal number of box destinations");
		}
		Set<Character> playerChars = playersByChar.keySet();
		Set<Character> boxPlayerChars = boxesByPlayerChar.keySet();
		for (char boxPlayerChar : boxPlayerChars) {
			if (!playerChars.contains(boxPlayerChar)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box player '" + boxPlayerChar + "' has no matching player on the board");
			}
		}
		for (char playerChar : playerChars) {
			if (!boxPlayerChars.contains(playerChar)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player '" + playerChar + "' has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		return new GameMap(map, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity object at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity in the game map.

	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
	 */
	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMaxHeight() {
		return maxHeight;
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\R");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be an integer");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1 || (undoLimit < 0 && undoLimit != -1)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be -1 or non-negative");
		}
		int height = lines.length - 1;

		// Determine max width among all lines (not just first line)
		int maxWidth = 0;
		for (int i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
			if (lines[i].length() > maxWidth) {
				maxWidth = lines[i].length();
			}
		}

		Map<Position, Entity> map = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Player> playersByChar = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playerPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, List<Box>> boxesByPlayerChar = new HashMap<>();
		int boxCount = 0;
		int destinationCount = 0;

		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			// Pad line with spaces if shorter than maxWidth
			if (line.length() < maxWidth) {
				line = String.format("%-" + maxWidth + "s", line);
			}
			for (int x = 0; x < maxWidth; x++) {
				char c = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity;
				if (c == '#') {
					entity = new Wall();
				} else if (c == '@') {
					entity = new Empty();
					destinations.add(pos);
					destinationCount++;
				} else if (c == '.') {
					entity = new Empty();
				} else if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) {
					if (playersByChar.containsKey(c)) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player character: " + c);
					}
					Player player = new Player(c - 'A');
					playersByChar.put(c, player);
					playerPositions.put(c, pos);
					entity = player;
				} else if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) {
					char playerChar = Character.toUpperCase(c);
					Box box = new Box(playerChar - 'A');
					boxesByPlayerChar.computeIfAbsent(playerChar, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(box);
					entity = box;
					boxCount++;
				} else if (c == ' ' || c == '\t') {
					// Treat spaces and tabs as empty
					entity = new Empty();
				} else {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid character in map: " + c);
				}
				map.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		if (playersByChar.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one player on the map");
		}
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes must equal number of box destinations");
		}
		Set<Character> playerChars = playersByChar.keySet();
		Set<Character> boxPlayerChars = boxesByPlayerChar.keySet();
		for (char boxPlayerChar : boxPlayerChars) {
			if (!playerChars.contains(boxPlayerChar)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box player '" + boxPlayerChar + "' has no matching player on the board");
			}
		}
		for (char playerChar : playerChars) {
			if (!boxPlayerChars.contains(playerChar)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player '" + playerChar + "' has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		return new GameMap(map, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity object at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity in the game map.
	 * @return  Entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return map.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	/**
	 * Put one entity at the given position in the game map.
	 * @param position  the position in the game map to put the entity.
	 * @param entity    the entity to put into game map.
	 */
	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(position, "Position cannot be null");
		Objects.requireNonNull(entity, "Entity cannot be null");
		map.put(position, entity);
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the undo limit of the game map.
	 * @return  undo limit.
	 */
	public Optional<Integer> getUndoLimit() {
		if (undoLimit == 0) {
			return Optional.empty();
		}
		return Optional.of(undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get all players' id as a set.
	 * @return  a set of player id.
	 */
	public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
		return map.values().stream().filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player).map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map.
	 * @return  maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMaxWidth() {
		return maxWidth;
	}

Response Text:---
The error occurs because the original `parse` method requires all map lines to have the same width, but the tests provide maps with lines of varying lengths. The fix is to remove the strict equality check on line lengths and instead determine the maximum width among all lines, then pad shorter lines with spaces to that width before parsing. This allows non-rectangular maps to be parsed correctly.

Here is the corrected `GameMap` class with the fixed `parse` method:

**Explanation:**  
- Removed the strict check that all lines must have the same length.  
- Instead, find the maximum width among all lines.  
- Pad shorter lines with spaces to this maximum width before parsing.  
- Spaces and tabs are treated as empty cells.

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;

/**
 * A Sokoban game board.
 * GameBoard consists of information loaded from map data, such as
 * <li>Width and height of the game map</li>
 * <li>Walls in the map</li>
 * <li>Box destinations</li>
 * <li>Initial locations of boxes and player</li>
 * <p/>
 * GameBoard is capable to create many GameState instances, each representing an ongoing game.
 */
public class GameMap {

	private final Map<Position, Entity> map;

	private final int maxWidth;

	private final int maxHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private final int undoLimit;

	/**
	 * Create a new GameMap with width, height, set of box destinations and undo limit.
	 *
	 * @param maxWidth     Width of the game map.
	 * @param maxHeight    Height of the game map.
	 * @param destinations Set of box destination positions.
	 * @param undoLimit    Undo limit.
	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
	 */
	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMaxHeight() {
		return maxHeight;
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\R");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be an integer");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1 || (undoLimit < 0 && undoLimit != -1)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be -1 or non-negative");
		}
		int height = lines.length - 1;

		// Determine max width among all lines (not just first line)
		int maxWidth = 0;
		for (int i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
			if (lines[i].length() > maxWidth) {
				maxWidth = lines[i].length();
			}
		}

		Map<Position, Entity> map = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Player> playersByChar = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playerPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, List<Box>> boxesByPlayerChar = new HashMap<>();
		int boxCount = 0;
		int destinationCount = 0;

		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			// Pad line with spaces if shorter than maxWidth
			if (line.length() < maxWidth) {
				line = String.format("%-" + maxWidth + "s", line);
			}
			for (int x = 0; x < maxWidth; x++) {
				char c = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity;
				if (c == '#') {
					entity = new Wall();
				} else if (c == '@') {
					entity = new Empty();
					destinations.add(pos);
					destinationCount++;
				} else if (c == '.') {
					entity = new Empty();
				} else if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) {
					if (playersByChar.containsKey(c)) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player character: " + c);
					}
					Player player = new Player(c - 'A');
					playersByChar.put(c, player);
					playerPositions.put(c, pos);
					entity = player;
				} else if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) {
					char playerChar = Character.toUpperCase(c);
					Box box = new Box(playerChar - 'A');
					boxesByPlayerChar.computeIfAbsent(playerChar, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(box);
					entity = box;
					boxCount++;
				} else if (c == ' ' || c == '\t') {
					// Treat spaces and tabs as empty
					entity = new Empty();
				} else {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid character in map: " + c);
				}
				map.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		if (playersByChar.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one player on the map");
		}
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes must equal number of box destinations");
		}
		Set<Character> playerChars = playersByChar.keySet();
		Set<Character> boxPlayerChars = boxesByPlayerChar.keySet();
		for (char boxPlayerChar : boxPlayerChars) {
			if (!playerChars.contains(boxPlayerChar)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box player '" + boxPlayerChar + "' has no matching player on the board");
			}
		}
		for (char playerChar : playerChars) {
			if (!boxPlayerChars.contains(playerChar)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player '" + playerChar + "' has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		return new GameMap(map, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity object at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity in the game map.
	 * @return  Entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {

public GameState(GameMap map) {
    this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
    this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
    this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));

	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {

			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);

Since `entities` is a map from `Position` to `Entity`, we can iterate over its entries, check if the entity is a `Player` and if its id matches the given id, then return that position. ```java
public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
    for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
        Entity entity = entry.getValue();
        if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {

}

				tempEntities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.entities = Collections.unmodifiableMap(tempEntities);

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));
		this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota().orElse(-1);
		Map<Position, Entity> tempEntities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
				tempEntities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.entities = Collections.unmodifiableMap(tempEntities);
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {
				return entry.getKey();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	/**
	 * Get current positions of all players in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions of all players.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)

The `isWin` method should check if every destination position in the game map is currently occupied by a box entity.  * Check whether the game wins or not.
 * The game wins only when all box destinations have been occupied by boxes.

					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);

- Save the current transition (which records all moves since the last checkpoint).
- Save the current undo quota.
- Push this information onto the `history` stack.
- Reset the current transition to a new empty one for the next moves.

But since the class design only has `Stack<Transition> history`, the simplest approach is to store the current transition (which contains moves) on the stack and rely on the `undoQuota` field being restored separately in `undo()`.

Given the constraints, the `checkpoint()` method should:

- Push a copy of the current transition onto the history stack.
- Reset the current transition to a new empty one.

The undo quota is a field in the class and will be handled in `undo()`.

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));
		this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota().orElse(-1);
		Map<Position, Entity> tempEntities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
				tempEntities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.entities = Collections.unmodifiableMap(tempEntities);
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {
				return entry.getKey();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {

		if (undoQuota < 0) {
			return Optional.empty();
		} else {
			return Optional.of(undoQuota);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Check whether the game wins or not. The game wins only when all box destinations have been occupied by boxes.

	public boolean isWin() {

package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxWidth() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));
		this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota().orElse(-1);
		Map<Position, Entity> tempEntities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
				tempEntities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.entities = Collections.unmodifiableMap(tempEntities);
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {
				return entry.getKey();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	/**
	 * Get current positions of all players in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions of all players.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity that is currently at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity.
	 * @return  the entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  a set of positions.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {
		if (undoQuota < 0) {
			return Optional.empty();
		} else {
			return Optional.of(undoQuota);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Check whether the game wins or not. The game wins only when all box destinations have been occupied by boxes.
	 * @return  true is the game wins.
	 */
	public boolean isWin() {
		return destinations.stream().allMatch(pos -> entities.get(pos) instanceof Box);
	}

	public void move(Position from, Position to) {
		Map<Position, Entity> modifiableEntities = new HashMap<>(this.entities);
		Entity entityToMove = modifiableEntities.get(from);
		modifiableEntities.put(to, entityToMove);
		modifiableEntities.put(from, new Empty());
		this.entities.put(to, entityToMove);
		this.entities.put(from, new Empty());
		this.currentTransition.add(from, to);
	}

	public void checkpoint() {
		history.push(currentTransition);
		currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public void undo() {
		if (undoQuota == 0) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No undo quota left.");
		}
		if (!history.isEmpty()) {
			Transition lastTransition = history.pop();
			Transition reverseTransition = lastTransition.reverse();
			applyTransition(reverseTransition);
		} else {
			currentTransition = new Transition();
		}
		undoQuota--;
	}
}

package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));
		this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota().orElse(-1);
		Map<Position, Entity> tempEntities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
				tempEntities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.entities = Collections.unmodifiableMap(tempEntities);
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {
				return entry.getKey();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	/**
	 * Get current positions of all players in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions of all players.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity that is currently at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity.
	 * @return  the entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  a set of positions.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {
		if (undoQuota < 0) {
			return Optional.empty();
		} else {
			return Optional.of(undoQuota);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Check whether the game wins or not. The game wins only when all box destinations have been occupied by boxes.
	 * @return  true is the game wins.
	 */
	public boolean isWin() {
		return destinations.stream().allMatch(pos -> entities.get(pos) instanceof Box);
	}

	public void move(Position from, Position to) {
		Map<Position, Entity> modifiableEntities = new HashMap<>(this.entities);
		Entity entityToMove = modifiableEntities.get(from);
		modifiableEntities.put(to, entityToMove);
		modifiableEntities.put(from, new Empty());
		this.entities.put(to, entityToMove);
		this.entities.put(from, new Empty());
		this.currentTransition.add(from, to);
	}

	public void checkpoint() {
		history.push(currentTransition);
		currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public void undo() {
		if (undoQuota == 0) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No undo quota left.");
		}
		if (!history.isEmpty()) {
			Transition lastTransition = history.pop();
			Transition reverseTransition = lastTransition.reverse();
			applyTransition(reverseTransition);
		} else {
			currentTransition = new Transition();
		}
		undoQuota--;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxWidth() {
		return this.boardWidth;
	}
}

Response Text:---
The error "The constructor GameState(GameMap) is undefined" occurs because the method named `GameState(GameMap map)` is declared with a `void` return type, making it a method, not a constructor. Constructors must not have a return type.

To fix this, remove the `void` return type so that it becomes a proper constructor.

Here is the corrected `GameState` constructor:

```java
public GameState(GameMap map) {
    this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
    this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
    this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));
    this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota().orElse(-1);
    Map<Position, Entity> tempEntities = new HashMap<>();
    for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
        for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
            tempEntities.put(pos, entity);
        }
    }
    this.entities = Collections.unmodifiableMap(tempEntities);
    this.history.clear();
    this.currentTransition = new Transition();
}
```

This change will define a proper constructor and resolve the compilation errors related to the missing constructor.

package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));
		this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota().orElse(-1);
		Map<Position, Entity> tempEntities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
				tempEntities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.entities = Collections.unmodifiableMap(tempEntities);
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {
				return entry.getKey();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	/**
	 * Get current positions of all players in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions of all players.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity that is currently at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity.
	 * @return  the entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  a set of positions.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {
		if (undoQuota < 0) {
			return Optional.empty();
		} else {
			return Optional.of(undoQuota);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Check whether the game wins or not. The game wins only when all box destinations have been occupied by boxes.
	 * @return  true is the game wins.
	 */
	public boolean isWin() {
		return destinations.stream().allMatch(pos -> entities.get(pos) instanceof Box);
	}

	public void move(Position from, Position to) {
		Map<Position, Entity> modifiableEntities = new HashMap<>(this.entities);
		Entity entityToMove = modifiableEntities.get(from);
		modifiableEntities.put(to, entityToMove);
		modifiableEntities.put(from, new Empty());
		this.entities.put(to, entityToMove);
		this.entities.put(from, new Empty());
		this.currentTransition.add(from, to);
	}

	public void checkpoint() {
		history.push(currentTransition);
		currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public void undo() {
		if (undoQuota == 0) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No undo quota left.");
		}
		if (!history.isEmpty()) {
			Transition lastTransition = history.pop();
			Transition reverseTransition = lastTransition.reverse();
			applyTransition(reverseTransition);
		} else {
			currentTransition = new Transition();
		}
		undoQuota--;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxWidth() {
		return this.boardWidth;
	}
}

- BOT: 
public GameState(GameMap map) {
    this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
    this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
    this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));
    this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota().orElse(-1);
    Map<Position, Entity> tempEntities = new HashMap<>();
    for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
        for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
            tempEntities.put(pos, entity);
        }
    }
    this.entities = Collections.unmodifiableMap(tempEntities);
    this.history.clear();
    this.currentTransition = new Transition();
}

Response Text:---
The error occurs because the constructor `GameState(GameMap)` is currently declared as a method (with a `void` return type) instead of a proper constructor. In Java, constructors must not have a return type, not even `void`. Your code has:

```java
public void GameState(GameMap map) { ... }
```

which is a method named `GameState`, not a constructor. This means no constructor with `GameMap` parameter exists, causing the compilation errors.

**Fix:** Remove the `void` return type to make it a proper constructor.

---

Here is the corrected `GameState` constructor:

```java
public GameState(GameMap map) {
    this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
    this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
    this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));
    this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota().orElse(-1);
    Map<Position, Entity> tempEntities = new HashMap<>();
    for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
        for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
            tempEntities.put(pos, entity);
        }
    }
    this.entities = Collections.unmodifiableMap(tempEntities);
    this.history.clear();
    this.currentTransition = new Transition();
}
```

		this.state = gameState;

	 * @param action The action received from the user.
	 * @return The result of the action.
	 */
	protected ActionResult processAction(Action action) {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * @param playerPosition The position of the player.
	 * @param move           One-step move. We assume every move has only one step.
	 * @return The action result for the move.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private ActionResult processOneStepMove(@NotNull Position playerPosition, @NotNull Move move) {
		final Position nextPlayerPos = move.nextPosition(playerPosition);
		final Entity nextEntity = this.state.getEntity(nextPlayerPos);

		if (nextEntity instanceof Empty) {
			this.state.move(playerPosition, nextPlayerPos); // move if next place is empty
			return new ActionResult.Success(move);
		}

		if (nextEntity instanceof Wall) {
			return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "You hit a wall.");
		}

		if (nextEntity instanceof Player) {
			return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "You hit another player.");
		}

		if (nextEntity instanceof Box box) {
			if (box.getPlayerId() != move.getInitiator()) {
				return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "You cannot move other players' boxes.");
			}
			final Position nextBoxPos = move.nextPosition(nextPlayerPos);
			if (!(this.state.getEntity(nextBoxPos) instanceof Empty))
				return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "Failed to push the box.");
			this.state.move(nextPlayerPos, nextBoxPos);
			this.state.move(playerPosition, nextPlayerPos);
			// Game history checkpoint reached if any box is moved.
			this.state.checkpoint();
			return new ActionResult.Success(move);
		}
		throw new ShouldNotReachException();
	}
}

Response Text:---
The method `processAction` should handle different types of `Action` objects (`Move`, `Undo`, `Exit`, and others). It should delegate the logic accordingly:

- For `Move`, find the player position and call `processOneStepMove`.
- For `Undo`, check if undo quota is available, then call `state.undo()`.
- For `Exit`, set the exit flag.
- For unknown or invalid actions, return a failed result.

Here is a complete implementation of `processAction`:

```java
/**
 * @param action The action received from the user.
 * @return The result of the action.
 */
protected ActionResult processAction(Action action) {
    if (action instanceof Move move) {
        Position playerPosition = state.findPlayerPosition(move.getInitiator());
        if (playerPosition == null) {
            return new ActionResult.Failed(move, PLAYER_NOT_FOUND);
        }
        return processOneStepMove(playerPosition, move);
    }

    if (action instanceof Undo undo) {
        if (state.getUndoQuota() <= 0) {
            return new ActionResult.Failed(undo, UNDO_QUOTA_RUN_OUT);
        }
        state.undo();
        return new ActionResult.Success(undo);
    }

    if (action instanceof Exit exit) {
        isExitSpecified = true;
        return new ActionResult.Success(exit);
    }

    return new ActionResult.Failed(action, new InvalidInput().toString());
}
```

This implementation covers all expected action types and returns appropriate results.

/**

 * @return The result of the action.
 */
protected ActionResult processAction(Action action) {
    if (action instanceof Move move) {
        var playerPositionOpt = state.findPlayerPosition(move.getInitiator());
        if (playerPositionOpt.isEmpty()) {
            return new ActionResult.Failed(move, PLAYER_NOT_FOUND);
        }
        return processOneStepMove(playerPositionOpt.get(), move);

            return new ActionResult.Failed(undo, UNDO_QUOTA_RUN_OUT);

        state.undo();
        return new ActionResult.Success(undo);
    }

    if (action instanceof Exit exit) {
        isExitSpecified = true;
        return new ActionResult.Success(exit);
    }

    return new ActionResult.Failed(action, new InvalidInput(action.getInitiator(), "Invalid input").toString());

The `run` method should implement the main game loop for the terminal Sokoban game. Typically, this involves rendering the current game state, reading user input, processing the input into an action, applying the action to the game state, and repeating until the game ends or the user quits.

Here is a complete implementation of the `run` method for `TerminalSokobanGame`:

```java
@Override
public void run() {
    boolean running = true;
    while (running) {
        // Render the current game state
        renderingEngine.render(gameState);

        // Get input from the user
        String input = inputEngine.getInput();

        // Convert input to an Action
        Action action = Action.fromInput(input);

        // Apply the action to the game state
        ActionResult result = gameState.applyAction(action);

        // Render the result of the action (e.g., messages)
        renderingEngine.renderResult(result);

        // Check if the game is over or user wants to quit
        if (result.isGameOver() || action.isQuit()) {
            running = false;
        }
    }
}
```

- The loop continues until the game is over or the player quits.

- The action is applied to the game state, returning an `ActionResult`.
- The result is rendered (e.g., messages or updated state).

package assignment.tui;

import assignment.entities.Box;

import java.io.PrintStream;

/**
 * A rendering engine that prints to the terminal.
 */
public class TerminalRenderingEngine implements RenderingEngine {

	private final PrintStream outputStream;

	/**
	 * @param outputStream The {@link PrintStream} to write the output to.
	 */
	public TerminalRenderingEngine(PrintStream outputStream) {
		this.outputStream = outputStream;
	}

	@Override
	public void render(@NotNull GameState state) {
		final StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
		for (int y = 0; y < state.getMapMaxHeight(); y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < state.getMapMaxWidth(); x++) {
				final Entity entity = state.getEntity(Position.of(x, y));
				char charToPrint = ' ';
				if (entity instanceof Wall) {
					charToPrint = '#';
				}
				if (entity instanceof Box box) {
					charToPrint = (char) (box.getPlayerId() + 'a');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Player player) {
					charToPrint = (char) (player.getId() + 'A');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Empty) {
					charToPrint = state.getDestinations().contains(new Position(x, y)) ? '@' : '.';
				}
				builder.append(charToPrint);
			}
			builder.append('\n');
		}
		outputStream.print(builder);
	}

	@Override
	public void message(String content) {
		// TODO
		// Hint: System.out is also a PrintStream.
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}
}

```java
@Override
public Action fetchAction() {
    final String inputLine = terminalScanner.nextLine().trim();

    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase(EXIT_COMMAND_TEXT)) {
        return new Exit();
    }

    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase("U")) {
        return new Undo();
    }

    Matcher matcher = MOVE_REGEX.matcher(inputLine);
    if (matcher.matches()) {
        char actionChar = matcher.group("action").toUpperCase().charAt(0);
        return new Move(actionChar);
    }

    return new InvalidInput(INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE);
}
```

**Explanation:**

- Trim the input to remove leading/trailing spaces.
- Check if the input matches the exit command (case-insensitive).
- Check if the input is "U" (undo command).
- Use the regex to check if the input is a valid move command.
- If none matches, return an `InvalidInput` action with a predefined message.
